label: run158 hsl endogenous curtailment
definition: run157 keeper config + NEW uncurtailed-VRE wiring for the no-HSL years (renewables.py _UNCURTAILED_FALLBACK_ISOS). ERCOT 2024/25 have no NP6 HSL parquet, so they previously fell back to EIA-930 net-of-curtailment delivered generation (curtailment baked in, LP could not re-curtail). Now the dispatch gets an uncurtailed potential: the weather-year delivered profile grossed up by the per-tech reference curtailment rate from the most recent HSL year (ERCOT 2023: wind 4.67%, solar 6.29%), so the LP curtails endogenously. 2023 is unchanged (uses its own HSL). Modeled re-curtailment: wind 2.2-2.4%, solar 0.4-1.7% across 2023-25 vs measured/reference 4.67%/6.29% — the reduced 6-zone network curtails less than ERCOT's local transmission constraints (a DIAGNOSTIC, never a fit target, rule #11). NOT-YET: governance gate (no attestation) + C1 CC_REGULAR over-run. NOTE: the C1 regression vs run157 is dominated by INTERVENING main-code changes since run157 was solved, not this HSL change — the 2023 control year (renewables byte-identical to run157) independently regressed CC_REGULAR +8.57 TWh / COAL_PRB -3.78 / ST_GAS -5.09; the HSL change adds only ~+1.5 CC / ~-4 COAL_PRB to 2024 on top of that. Pre-existing ERCOT CC-over-run on main to investigate separately.
